---
title: "Figures S3 and S6: state occupancy and discount factor"
author: "Annice Najafi"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, comment = "")
# The repository root is the parent of notebooks/ unless DTMDP_ROOT is set.
root <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("DTMDP_ROOT", ".."), winslash = "/")
Sys.setenv(DTMDP_ROOT = root)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
source(file.path(root, "R", "notebook_code.R"))   # script code without cat() and banner comments
out_dir <- Sys.getenv("DTMDP_OUT", file.path(root, "output"))
if (file.exists(file.path(out_dir, "data_driven", "data_driven_matrices.rds")))
  Sys.setenv(DTMDP_REUSE_MATRICES = "1")
script <- file.path(root, "figures", "regen_figures.R")
```

This notebook reproduces Figures S3 and S6 of the Supplementary Material (`output/figures/fig02_state_occupancy.pdf` and `output/figures/fig07_discount_factor.pdf`).

```{r figS3-S6-script, code = notebook_code(script)}
```

```{r figS3-show, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8}
print(p_fig02)
```

```{r figS6-show, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5.5}
print(p_fig07)
```
